comment.body: Investigation note: Customer dashboards in observability beta show no metrics after upgrade. Engineering should check data ingestion for regressions, review dashboard data source linkages, and confirm no recent config changes have affected metric visibility since the beta launch.
Thank you for reporting the dashboard metrics issue in the observability beta. Our engineering team is actively investigating and we'll keep you updated as we make progress.

reply:
